title: Nutty Spanish Walnut Skillet
description: A rich and savory one-pan dish featuring walnuts and a hint of smokiness, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This Ayurvedic-friendly recipe balances Rajasic energies with grounding ingredients.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and reduce heat to medium.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped walnuts and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the Spanish smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken breast to the skillet and spoon some of the walnut mixture over the top.
Simmer the chicken in the walnut mixture for 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the chicken with the walnut mixture spooned over the top, garnished with chopped fresh parsley and crusty bread on the side.
